title: CNP project registry record
description: One record per project. The source of truth for where a project runs. Consumed by the Argo CD ApplicationSet, the blackbox probe target list and the cnp-clean job.

name.description: Project identifier. Must match the filename and the Keycloak group prefix.

owner.description: Keycloak username of the project creator. Informational; RBAC lives in Keycloak groups.

targetCloud.description: The cloud this project runs on. Immutable after creation (D-01): changing it is a re-create. Must match the name of a registered Argo CD cluster secret.

logRetention.description: How long Loki keeps every log of this project. Unset lets each app choose (default 14d); set, it overrides the apps.

status.description: active = reconciled normally. suspended = keep resources, stop deploying. decommissioning = cnp-clean is working on it.

environments.description: The environments this project may use (D-11). Listing staging allows apps of the project to opt into it, up to maxApps; each app still chooses with apps[].environments.

offhours.description: Whether offhours-guard scales this environment down outside business hours. Enforcement is local to the target cluster.

dbInstances.description: CNPG instance count for this environment (D-08). Prod should be at least 2 once the cluster can carry it.

maxApps.description: How many apps of the project may run this environment. Set by a platform admin: a staging environment roughly doubles an app's daytime memory. Ignored for prod.

apps.description: Applications deployed in this project. The ApplicationSet generates one Argo CD Application per app component per environment.

type.description: fullstack renders frontend + backend components; static renders a single app component.

repoURL.description: Original application repository, created from a template or imported through CMP.

environments.description: Where this app runs. prod alone is today's behaviour; adding staging gives the app a <project>-<app>-stg namespace, its own Applications and an image updater that only takes release candidates (vX.Y.Z-rc.N). Prod then changes only through a promotion from the CMP.

hostnames.description: Public hostnames this app answers on, keyed by environment. Generated from the naming convention; stated explicitly so probes and tunnel routes read one source.

sourceRevision.description: Immutable application/values Git commit validated by the central import CI. Omit for catalog HEAD behavior.

chartRevision.description: Immutable platform chart Git commit rendered and scanned by the central import CI.

imageTag.description: Unique import image tag. Combined with imageDigest by Argo CD.

imageDigest.description: Digest of the image built and scanned by the central CI.

features.description: Per-project platform add-ons, rendered by cnp-project-base into <project>-system.

gateway.description: Per-project Gateway and stable Service (D-05). False keeps the project on the shared gateway.

tunnel.description: Per-project Cloudflare connector with Git-delivered ingress rules (D-06).

keycloak.description: Per-project Keycloak IAMaaS (D-04). False keeps the project on the central Keycloak tenant realm, which does not survive an on-prem outage.
